title: Module 10 quiz — Kubernetes and OpenShift
description: Eight questions on Deployments, Services, Routes, probes, Secrets, and BayPay incidents. Method over lucky kubectl nouns.

questions.prompt: A Deployment owns ReplicaSets that own Pods. What does deleting one payment-service pod do?
choices: The ReplicaSet creates a replacement to match spec.replicas
questions.explanation: Pods are cattle. The controller restores the replica count.

questions.prompt: OpenShift Route vs Kubernetes Ingress for payments.apps.baypay.example?
choices: Routes are L4 only; Ingress is a database
Different product objects for the same job: L7 front door onto a Service
Routes require a live ND cell
questions.explanation: Teach both. Do not require a live OCP cluster in this course.

questions.prompt: Pods are Running but Ready 0/1 and the Service has no Endpoints. First honest class?
choices: Readiness (or selector) is failing — traffic will not flow even if the process exists
questions.explanation: Ready gate + selector both produce empty Endpoints. Describe the pod and the Service before guessing TLS.

questions.prompt: Why must liveness and readiness be different URLs on payment-service?
choices: Kubernetes forbids the same path twice
Liveness = process should be killed; readiness = should receive traffic. A slow DB check on liveness restarts a healthy JVM
Actuator can only mount one mapping

questions.prompt: kubectl describe shows Last State OOMKilled, limit 512Mi, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Xmx512m. Working model?
choices: cgroup killed the process; heap reserved the whole limit; native had nowhere to go
questions.explanation: Same JVM rule, kube evidence. Do not raise replica count as the first fix.

questions.prompt: A Secret has key password but the container env is BAYPAY_DB_PASSWORD. What happens?
choices: The app does not receive the value it was written for — fail-fast or DB auth errors
questions.explanation: Key names are the contract. envFrom is not magic synonym matching.

questions.prompt: Service selector app=payment, pods labeled app=payment-service. Symptom?
choices: Endpoints empty; Ingress/Route 503 even if pods are Ready

questions.prompt: Why is a live OpenShift cluster not required to finish Module 10?
choices: The course is simulation-first: YAML, Routes-vs-Ingress, and gated dumps teach the model; OCP is optional extra
Kubernetes cannot express Routes on paper
questions.explanation: Same delivery rule as WebSphere ND: architecture + evidence, not a licensed cluster.
